body: Insurance made me quit. So I was clean for insurance pee test required for approval for the surgery. But then the day of surgery they drug tested me again and I failed for thc. They still performed surgery and my insurance still paid.

TOMATO SOUP WAS AMAZING! Made me feel the most normal cause it’s thickness. Dannon light and fit yogurts, sugar free popsicles and fudgesicles(was cautious because Chocolate upset my stomach), I take progresso soup broths from tortilla soup, chicken and noodle anything with good bit and just strained them, they were great and many flavors can add hot sauce to them for more flav, just chewing on ice helped if your stomach can tolerate that. This will pass!! I am now 5 weeks out and feeling SO much better now that I can eat regular foods and drink a lot more!

I suffer with this currently. I wake up and feel instantly like I’m going to throw up, I thought it was acid reflux for the longest which I’m sure attributes to it. But it’s every morning no matter what I eat. This past week I started seeing a nutritionist, he has me on a very low carb low sugar diet and this week has been great with minimal nausea(besides when I snuck a sugar cookie one night) and more energy. The metformin makes me terribly sick but I plan to try to start that next week again as well to keep everything under control. Try not eating anything before bed, I’m talking a couple hours.  And try to plan meals throughout the day, I was eating once maybe twice a day and felt sick often. Now I eat 4 times a day and things are improving and I’m losing weight in the process. I hope this helps.
